// diagnostic

E0398

Bit signs and logic signs are different operators.

What

Bit signs and logic signs are different operators.

Why

`!` negates a Bool and `!=` compares, while `~` flips integer bits and `~=` updates by exclusive-or.

Fix

Write `~value` to flip integer bits, `!flag` to negate a Bool, and `!=` to test that two values differ.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0398: Tests/UI/bit_complement_on_bool.stderr.

Error [jet.BitLogicMixup]: `~` flips integer bits; `!` negates a Bool
  --> Tests/UI/bit_complement_on_bool.jet:4:11
    |
  4 |     print(~ready)
    |           ^^^^^^
 Why: `~value` is the bitwise complement of an integer, and a Bool has no bits to flip
 Fix: Write `!flag` to negate the Bool
